# Best Slim Qi2 / MagSafe Power Banks for iPhone 17

The iPhone 17 supports **Qi2.2 at 25W** wireless charging on iOS 26 ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w), [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)). Slim banks force a trade-off between thinness, capacity and charging speed, so here are the best picks for each priority.

## Top picks

| Pick | Thickness / Weight | Capacity | Wireless | Price |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**, best slim overall | 0.34 in / 122 g | 5,000 mAh | 15W Qi2 | $54.99 |
| **INIU SnapGo Air 10K**, best slim 25W | 0.5 in / 195 g | 10,000 mAh | 25W Qi2.2 | ~$43–55 |
| **ReelCharge ReelSafe**, slim with a semi-solid-state battery | 0.35 in / 119 g | 5,000 mAh | 15W | $49.99 |
| **Baseus PicoGo Air AM71**, thinnest | 0.27 in / 104 g | 5,000 mAh | 7.5W only | ~$53–70 |

### 1. Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim): best for most people
- 0.34" thick ("as slim as an Apple Pencil"), 4.3 oz, Qi2-certified 15W, 20W two-way USB-C.
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's MagSafe battery and says it runs cooler than competitors ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)).
- One limit: 5K gives roughly 60–75% of a charge.
- **Buy:** [anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank). Anker lists $54.99 with a $5 auto-applied code.

### 2. INIU SnapGo Air 10K: best if you want full 25W speed and more capacity
- 0.5" thick, 25W Qi2.2 wireless, 45W wired, LED display, and an included lanyard-style 60W cable.
- Macworld rates it "equal slimmest 10K MagSafe battery pack" ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)). Android Central found it a standout value at $42.99–$48.99 on Amazon ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **Buy:** the Amazon and INIU links are in the [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge).
- **Equally slim 10K alternatives from Macworld:**
  - **Ugreen MagFlow Pro 10K** had the best capacity test score, with 25W wireless, 45W wired and a built-in cable.
  - **Kuxiu S4** has a semi-solid-state battery and a kickstand.

### 3. Baseus PicoGo Air AM71: only if thinness is everything
At 0.27" and 104 g it is the thinnest pack tested. However, it charges at only 7.5W wireless, which is slow on an iPhone 17 ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).

## Also worth knowing
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10K, 25W Qi2.2, 45W wired):** this one isn't sold as "slim." A deal site reports $59.99, or $53.99 with code **AM52**, tested on 2026-10-24. The link is an affiliate link: [dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). The INIU is cheaper and slimmer with similar specs.
- **iPhone Air owners:** the Air caps wireless charging at 20W, and Apple's own $99 MagSafe battery only charges at 12W ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)).
- **Cases:** use a MagSafe case under about 2.5 mm thick for a solid connection ([Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)).

**Bottom line:** get the **Anker Nano 5K Slim** for the most pocketable everyday top-up. Get the **INIU SnapGo Air 10K** for full 25W speed and nearly two charges in a still-slim body.
